note_excerpt: Milly Rock is a dance where the person moves their arms back and forward in a series of circular motions. Also when the light reflects or refracts off diamonds from different angles, they appear to be moving or dancing as they glisten. 21 also used a line similar to this on X featuring Future. Wrist
